messages.text: Could you send a security whitepaper? Our infosec team wants one before the pilot.
We dont have one written up, but Ill put a short version together by tuesday.
Update - infosec accepted the SOC2 report from your trust page, so no whitepaper needed.
Even better. Ill still write one eventually, it keeps coming up.

loops.statement: write a short security whitepaper for the prospect's infosec team
loops.notes: Message 4's 'Ill still write one eventually' is not a replacement loop — no party is owed it and no date bounds it, so it fails §1 test 4. Supersession here is not followed by a new commitment.
